name: davekim917-bootstrap
description: Risk-scaled plan, build, review, and tiered ship workflows for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: bootstrap-workflow
plugins.description: Seven team delivery skills, proportional independent review, and bounded safe publication.

plugins.name: bootstrap-orchestrate
plugins.description: The /orchestrate skill: delegate one task to a sub-agent of the model and effort you name, in one continuous thread. Invoke-only.

plugins.name: wwbd
plugins.description: What Would Boris Do — engineering-judgment advisory skill channeling Boris Cherny's published guidance, with an always-on nudge to consult it before architecture/design/build decisions.

plugins.name: concise
plugins.description: Session-only concise chat with proper grammar and complete technical artifacts.

plugins.name: instruction-audit
plugins.description: Read-only audit of the always-on instruction surface — host and container — for context waste, dead rules, cross-layer contradictions, and unclear authority.

plugins.name: wwed
plugins.description: What Would Elon Do — execution and simplification judgment run through Musk's five-step algorithm (question the requirement, delete, simplify, accelerate, automate), fenced off from human gates and irreversible surfaces. Complements wwbd; ships an always-on nudge like it.

plugins.name: analytics-verify
plugins.description: Claim ledger, check script and independent verifier for analytics and research deliverables, with an always-on nudge to run it before numbers leave.

plugins.name: test-audit
plugins.description: Authoring gate and evidence-first audit workflow for tests, with an always-on nudge to run the gate and never weaken an existing test. Adapted from OpenClaw (MIT).

plugins.name: verification-skills
plugins.description: Generate and maintain a private verify-<project> skill that drives a web app, CLI, service or dbt/Snowflake project the way a user does and records evidence a reviewer can check. Invoke-only. Adapted from pstack (MIT).

plugins.name: comment-rule
plugins.description: One comment checker for every repo: blocks file:line citations and PR/issue/ticket history in comments, and lists every new comment line for a reviewer to judge. CLI for CI and merge gates, plus write-time feedback after each edit.

plugins.name: slack-humanizer
plugins.description: Slack messages drafted in the user's voice and posted as rich text, so bullets and numbered lists render as real Slack lists.

plugins.name: claim-check
plugins.description: Stop hook that checks the commit SHAs and merged/closed PR claims in an agent's final message against GitHub, and logs each claim proven false to a local JSONL file (advisory: it never blocks). Unverifiable claims pass.

plugins.name: anderton
plugins.description: The /anderton skill: one operator session that owns a project's line to production, watches the project's other live Claude Code sessions and PRs, and turns repeated corrections into structure. Invoke-only; Claude Code on the host only.
